text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My three years with Transcend flew by in 
the blink of an eye. One day, as I was 
pondering that...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Trai-chan. Do you remember the hot springs 
trip?
choice_data_list: You won this in the raffle, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In that case, it's safely tucked away in 
the desk drawer.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: All right, haven't lost it.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Things have finally settled down, so come 
on, let's hit the hot springs!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I looked into all sorts of info, from 
nearby shops to other things.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
You know... honestly, this was the one 
thing I've been looking forward to that 
kept me going...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for hiding it from you. But I 
just... can't keep it hidden anymore!
choice_data_list:
It's fine, you don't need to say another 
word...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "Ugh, Trainy...! I... I'm...!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah, looks like you can choose from 3 kinds 
of dessert for dinner at the inn~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—After that little farce, we decided to 
plan out the schedule for our hot spring 
trip together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Messing around like this was a lot of 
fun. I have plenty of silly memories too. 
But—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The races where I gave it everything, 
poured my heart out, and ran with all my 
soul... Are etched even deeper into my 
heart."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...That went by in a flash, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The story is still ongoing. Even so, 
reflecting on the time that had passed 
brought a quiet pang of loneliness to 
their heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days had quickly passed since 
planning the hot springs trip. The day 
finally arrived without a hitch, and we 
arrived at the hot springs town with 
Transcend.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
We've put our bags down, so shall we head 
to the hideout?!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"First stop. It's a shop that serves 
delicacies of mysterious origins."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...Are you prepared?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Alright, shall we head out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Accompanied by Transcend, who was in 
somewhat higher spirits than usual, we 
visited one hidden-gem spot after another.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
So spiiicyyy!! This is way too much... 
Huh, wait, why'd it suddenly get 
sweet...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Delicacies served at every destination. 
Drafting reviews, taking photos, and 
shooting videos.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Review or not, I don't plan on releasing 
this video to the public.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, she flashed a peace sign at 
the camera.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Because from here on out—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Because it's a secret adventure without a 
map~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I heard there's a small hot spring in the 
mountains just past here.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It'd be a waste if other people found out, 
so let's keep this our secret between us 
and the locals.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the source is reliable. The landlady 
at the inn told me, after all.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, but still.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Well, I guess we'll find out once 
we get there.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...You 'kay?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Ah, doesn't look good.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"We walked quite a bit, didn't we? I guess 
that's what makes it a hidden hot spring."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I followed behind Transcend as she guided 
me, but... my knees began to tremble from 
the sheer distance.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's go home!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Come on, hop on my back. You can't walk, 
can you?
choice_data_list: What about the hidden hot spring?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It's a bit further ahead. ...Though, I 
don't really know if it's actually there.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It's just a story about a small hot spring 
from long ago. It's so far away that 
nobody goes there anymore, and it might 
even be buried by now.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I just thought it'd be really nice 
to have one, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Even if you can't get in, if we could just 
look for it together... you know?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Whoa, Trai-chan?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She stands straight up. Her knees are 
still shaking, but it doesn't matter.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The hot spring might already be gone. Yet 
for some reason, I felt it might just fill 
the loneliness that had sprouted in my 
heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, we walked for a while longer, 
and just as my legs were finally reaching 
their limit—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Mm? This smell... sulfur?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoaaaa...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: A hidden hot spring~~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Hot springs at a traditional inn 
really are the best, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Trai-chan, you still alive?
choice_data_list: About half of it, I guess...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. It was a shame we couldn't soak in 
the secret hot spring... but hey, at least 
we found it, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Heading toward the steam, there was 
indeed hot water there. ...A puddle of hot 
water, that is."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At that moment, exhaustion hit me all at 
once, and I collapsed...
choice_data_list:
Thanks for carrying me on your back on the 
way home.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: It's fine, really.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Because, even with that included, I'm 
satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Trainer-chan and everyone, I 
could run the best race ever... and have a 
cinema that never ends.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Getting so many thrills, and discovering 
sides of myself I never knew existed.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I was thinking like, "Man, I'm so happy."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Like ordinary everyday life, ya mean? 
...I guess I need that kind of stuff, 
too."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Just that one thing was still missin' a 
little, y'see.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Do you understand?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Without saying anything more, Transcend 
tilts her head."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"What was missing... was probably the same 
'loneliness' I felt. In other words, it's 
quite simple—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At this milestone, I simply wanted a new 
memory to prove that this was not the end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"You get it, don't ya?" Transcend 
chuckled. Even lying face down in 
exhaustion, looking completely pathetic—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond between Transcend and 
myself...
